title: Bissell mentions the 1933 Magenta crash

plain: The story goes that in June 1933 a disc-shaped craft came down near Magenta, a town in northern Italy. An economist and former presidential adviser, Harold Malmgren, says he heard of it from Richard Bissell, a senior CIA figure, who told him that this did not start last week and mentioned 1933 Magenta. A whistleblower, David Grusch, says it was the first recovery of such a craft in Europe and that a partly intact vehicle was found. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, repeats these accounts many times. He describes a disc about 10 to 12 meters across, a news blackout under the dictator Mussolini, and the craft later being sent to the United States, in one version through the Vatican. A former Air Force officer, Robert Salas, points to a new book by the Italian researcher Roberto Pinotti, which he says shows documents proving it, and says Mussolini put the radio inventor Guglielmo Marconi in charge of studying the craft. The tellers add different details, and Michels himself once calls it hypothetical. If true, it would mean governments were secretly holding unknown craft more than a decade before the famous Roswell case of 1947.
